text:
Maya: Quick ask — anyone got go-to spots near the SF office (Mission St) for a team lunch when folks visit? cheap-ish + decent wifi for a quick huddle afterwards
Liam: Taqueria La Cumbre is solid and fast. best carnitas in a hurry. cash/card, lines move quick. :taco:
Ana: If you want sit-down + quieter, Souvla has great salads and rotisserie. good for mixed diets (veg options). around 15–20pp.
Devon: For groups, I usually do a burrito/sharing spread from Taqueria or a pizza drop from Little Star. both are office-friendly.
Katrina: If someone is vegan/halal, Gracias Madre is a good option and walkable from Mission. try the jackfruit tacos.
Maya: Awesome recs — any recs for visiting teammates who land late and need dinner near the office?
Liam: Nighthawk-ish: The Avocado Club and most Mission spots are open lateish. Also there’s a ramen place (Mensho?) that’s open late and great when flights land after 8p.
Ana: For quick airport grabs — near SFO Terminal 3 there’s Blue Bottle + a decent poke place. if you want local snacks to bring back: Bi-Rite ice cream is a crowd-pleaser.
Devon: Travel tip: avoid bringing the whole team to high-tourist places on Fridays (lines). Hit smaller spots Tues–Thurs.
Katrina: For special occasions, Kokkari (up by Embarcadero) is pricier but impresses visiting execs.
Maya: Any recs for NYC or London for when folks are traveling there? visiting teammates keep asking
Liam: NYC — Xi'an Famous Foods (quick, spicy), or Prince Street Pizza for a short but iconic line. casual, wallet-friendly.
Ana: London — Dishoom is lovely (reservations recommended). Shoreditch has tons of good quick options too; try Flat Iron for steak without breaking the bank.
Devon: For airport food in London, grab something at Borough Market if you have time — great variety and nice to walk around.
TravelBot: quick note: team discount at Little Star (COFFEE20) still works for pickup orders placed by 3pm — internal tip.
Maya: Perfect — I'm compiling a short "visiting us" doc for new hires with a few safe bets and dietary notes. will add these. thanks! :raised_hands:

Ana: I'll add vegan/gluten-free flags while Maya drafts.
